```rust
use crate::sample_pipelines::Variants;
use crate::{
  cloud::Row,
  cloud_lod::{LodWalk, Projection},
  text_gpu_support::{GpuCtx, resource_group},
};
use std::{collections::HashMap, rc::Rc};
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;
const MAX_RECORDS: usize = 4096;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct View {
  pub anchor:[f64;3],
  pub eye: [f32; 3],
  pub ortho_h: f32,
  pub lod_px: f32,
}
impl Default for View {
  fn default() -> Self {
    Self { anchor:[0.;3],eye: [0., 0., 3.], ortho_h: 0., lod_px: 2. }
  }
}
impl View {
  pub fn camera(camera:&crate::camera::Camera)->Self {Self::anchored(camera,[0.;3])}
  pub fn anchored(camera:&crate::camera::Camera,anchor:[f64;3])->Self {
    let forward = camera.orientation.rotate_vector(session_rust::Vector::y_axis());
    Self {
      anchor,
      eye: std::array::from_fn(|i| (camera.target[i] - anchor[i] - forward[i] * camera.distance) as f32),
      ortho_h: if camera.projection == crate::camera::Projection::Orthographic {
        (camera.distance * std::f64::consts::FRAC_PI_6.tan()) as f32
      } else {
        0.
      },
      lod_px: 2.,
    }
  }
}
struct Columns {
  _page:Option<Rc<crate::page_cache::Held<crate::range_page::Page>>>,
  positions: wgpu::Buffer,
  colors: wgpu::Buffer,
  normals: wgpu::Buffer,
  has_normals: bool,
}
impl Columns {
  fn new(ctx: &GpuCtx, row: &Row) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
    let source = &row.prepared.source;
    let count = source.len();
    let limit = ctx.device.limits().max_storage_buffer_binding_size as usize;
    if count.checked_mul(12).is_none_or(|n| n > limit) {
      return Err("Cloud positions exceed this device's storage binding limit");
    }
    let positions = source.coords().iter().flat_map(|v| (*v as f32).to_ne_bytes()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let colors = (0..count)
      .map(|i| {
        if source.colors().is_empty() {
          0xff00_0000
        } else {
          let c = &source.colors()[i * 4..i * 4 + 4];
          (c[0] as u32) | (c[1] as u32) << 8 | (c[2] as u32) << 16 | (c[3] as u32) << 24
        }
      })
      .flat_map(u32::to_ne_bytes)
      .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let has_normals = !source.normals().is_empty();
    let normals = source
      .normals()
      .chunks_exact(3)
      .map(|n| crate::cloud_normals::oct16(&[n[0], n[1], n[2]]).unwrap_or(0))
      .flat_map(u32::to_ne_bytes)
      .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    Ok(Self {
      _page:None,
      positions: buffer(&ctx.device, "original cloud positions", &positions),
      colors: buffer(&ctx.device, "original cloud colors", &colors),
      normals: buffer(&ctx.device, "original cloud normals", &normals),
      has_normals,
    })
  }
  fn page(ctx:&GpuCtx,held:Rc<crate::page_cache::Held<crate::range_page::Page>>)->Result<Self,&'static str> {
    let page=&held.value;let count=page.rows.end-page.rows.start;
    if u64::from(count)*12>u64::from(ctx.device.limits().max_storage_buffer_binding_size) {return Err("Cloud page exceeds the device storage binding limit");}
    let positions=page.display.iter().flat_map(|value|value.to_ne_bytes()).collect::<Vec<_>>();let colors=(0..count as usize).flat_map(|i|page.colors.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0xff00_0000).to_ne_bytes()).collect::<Vec<_>>();let normals=page.normals.iter().flat_map(|v|v.to_ne_bytes()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    Ok(Self {positions:buffer(&ctx.device,"streamed source positions",&positions),colors:buffer(&ctx.device,"streamed source colours",&colors),normals:buffer(&ctx.device,"streamed source normals",&normals),has_normals:!page.normals.is_empty(),_page:Some(held)})
  }
  fn bytes(&self) -> u64 {
    self.positions.size() + self.colors.size() + self.normals.size()
  }
}
fn buffer(device: &wgpu::Device, label: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> wgpu::Buffer {
  device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
    label: Some(label),
    contents: if bytes.is_empty() { &[0; 4] } else { bytes },
    usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE,
  })
}
enum Keep {Resident(Rc<session_rust::PointCloud>),Stream(Rc<crate::range_cloud::Prepared>)}
impl Keep {
  fn key(&self,first:u32)->(usize,u32) {match self {Self::Resident(source)=>(Rc::as_ptr(source) as usize,first),Self::Stream(source)=>(Rc::as_ptr(source) as usize,first)}}
}
struct RowView {
  keep:Keep,
  id:crate::scene::ObjectId,
  model:session_rust::Xform,
  nodes:Rc<Vec<crate::cloud::LodNode>>,
  descriptor:crate::cloud::Cloud,
  controls_visible:bool,
  point_px:f32,
  rows:std::ops::Range<u32>,
  address:u32,
}
impl RowView {
  fn resident(row:&Row)->Self {Self {keep:Keep::Resident(row.prepared.source.clone()),id:row.id,model:row.model.clone(),nodes:row.prepared.nodes.clone(),descriptor:row.prepared.descriptor(),controls_visible:row.controls_visible,point_px:if row.point_px>0. {row.point_px} else {row.prepared.source.point_size as f32},rows:0..row.prepared.source.len() as u32,address:0}}
  fn streamed(row:&crate::range_cloud::Row,rows:std::ops::Range<u32>,address:u32)->Self {Self {keep:Keep::Stream(row.prepared.clone()),id:row.id,model:row.model.clone(),nodes:row.prepared.nodes.clone(),descriptor:crate::cloud::Cloud {spacing:row.prepared.source.lod.spacing[0] as f32,node_first:0,node_count:row.prepared.nodes.len() as u32,resident:row.prepared.source.fields.count},controls_visible:row.controls_visible,point_px:if row.point_px>0. {row.point_px} else {row.prepared.source.properties.point_px},rows,address}}
  fn key(&self)->(usize,u32,u32) {let (source,first)=self.keep.key(self.rows.start);(source,first,self.rows.end)}
}
struct Draw {
  row:RowView,
  columns:Rc<Columns>,
  records:wgpu::Buffer,
  group:wgpu::BindGroup,
  visible:bool,
  pickable:bool,
  selected:bool,
  color:Option<[f32;4]>,
  total:u32,
}
struct Image {
  texture: wgpu::Texture,
  view: wgpu::TextureView,
  bytes: u64,
}
impl Image {
  fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, size: [u32; 2], format: wgpu::TextureFormat, bytes: u64) -> Self {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
      label: Some("cached cloud image"),
      size: wgpu::Extent3d { width: size[0], height: size[1], depth_or_array_layers: 1 },
      mip_level_count: 1,
      sample_count: 1,
      dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
      format,
      usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
      view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&Default::default());
    Self { texture, view, bytes: bytes * size[0] as u64 * size[1] as u64 }
  }
}
impl Drop for Image {
  fn drop(&mut self) {
    self.texture.destroy();
  }
}
struct Targets {
  color: Image,
  depth: Image,
  ids: Image,
  size: [u32; 2],
  group: wgpu::BindGroup,
}
#[derive(PartialEq)]
struct Key {
  anchor:[u64;3],
  transform: [f32; 16],
  size: [u32; 2],
  density: u32,
  eye: [u32; 3],
  ortho: u32,
  lod: u32,
  revision: u64,
  clipping:u64,
}

pub struct Lane {
  clipping:wgpu::BindGroup,clip_revision:u64,
  point: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
  resolve:Variants<wgpu::RenderPipeline>,
  resolver:wgpu::ShaderModule,format:wgpu::TextureFormat,samples:u32,
  pick: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
  edl:f32,
  settings: wgpu::Buffer,
  settings_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
  columns_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
  image_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
  window: wgpu::Buffer,
  window_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
  draws: Vec<Draw>,
  targets: Option<Targets>,
  key: Option<Key>,
  revision: u64,
  pub uploads: u64,
  pub preparations: u64,
  pub skips: u64,
  pub total: u64,
}
impl Lane {
  pub fn new(ctx: &GpuCtx, format: wgpu::TextureFormat,clipping:&wgpu::BindGroup) -> Self {
    let layouts = layouts(ctx);
    let make_buffer = |label, size| {
      ctx.device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        size,
        usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        mapped_at_creation: false,
      })
    };
    let settings = make_buffer("cloud frame settings", 48);
    let settings_group =
      resource_group(ctx, &layouts.uniform, "cloud frame settings", [(0, settings.as_entire_binding())]);
    let window = make_buffer("cloud pick origin", 16);
    let window_group = resource_group(ctx, &layouts.window, "cloud pick origin", [(0, window.as_entire_binding())]);
    let ([point, resolve, pick],resolver) = pipelines(ctx, format, &layouts);
    Self {clipping:clipping.clone(),clip_revision:0,
      point,
      resolve:Variants::new(resolve,1),resolver,format,samples:1,
      pick,
      settings,
      settings_group,edl:0.25,
      columns_layout: layouts.columns,
      image_layout: layouts.image,
      window,
      window_group,
      draws: Vec::new(),
      targets: None,
      key: None,
      revision: 0,
      uploads: 0,
      preparations: 0,
      skips: 0,
      total: 0,
    }
  }
  pub fn set_samples(&mut self,ctx:&GpuCtx,samples:u32) {
    assert!(matches!(samples,1|4));self.samples=samples;if self.targets.is_none(){return;}
    self.resolve.select(samples,||pipeline(&ctx.device,&self.resolver,&[&self.image_layout,&self.pick.get_bind_group_layout(1),&self.point.get_bind_group_layout(0)],"vertex","color",&[self.format,crate::primitive_image::FORMAT],samples));
  }
  pub fn set_edl(&mut self,ctx:&GpuCtx,value:f32) {
    let value=if value.is_finite(){value.max(0.)}else{0.};if value==self.edl{return;}
    self.edl=value;ctx.queue.write_buffer(&self.settings,12,&value.to_ne_bytes());
  }
  pub fn set_clipping(&mut self,revision:u64){self.clip_revision=revision;}
  pub fn set_scene(
    &mut self,
    ctx: &GpuCtx,
    scene: &crate::scene::Scene,
    selected: &[crate::scene::ObjectId],
  ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    let mut cache:HashMap<(usize,u32,u32),Rc<Columns>>=self.draws.iter().map(|draw|(draw.row.key(),draw.columns.clone())).collect();
    let mut candidates=Vec::new();
    for row in scene.clouds() {let view=RowView::resident(row);let key=view.key();let columns=if let Some(columns)=cache.get(&key) {columns.clone()} else {let columns=Rc::new(Columns::new(ctx,row)?);self.uploads+=1;cache.insert(key,columns.clone());columns};candidates.push((view,columns));}
    for row in scene.streams() {let mut address=0u32;for page in row.prepared.pages() {
      let view=RowView::streamed(row,page.value.rows.clone(),address);let key=view.key();let columns=if let Some(columns)=cache.get(&key) {columns.clone()} else {let columns=Rc::new(Columns::page(ctx,page.clone())?);self.uploads+=1;cache.insert(key,columns.clone());columns};address=address.checked_add(page.value.rows.end-page.value.rows.start).filter(|value|*value<=crate::sub_id::LIMIT).ok_or("Streamed pick addresses exceed their source table")?;candidates.push((view,columns));
    }}
    let mut old=std::mem::take(&mut self.draws);let mut draws=Vec::with_capacity(candidates.len());
    for (row,columns) in candidates {
      let (records,group)=if let Some(i)=old.iter().position(|draw|draw.row.id==row.id&&draw.row.rows==row.rows&&Rc::ptr_eq(&draw.columns,&columns)) {let draw=old.swap_remove(i);(draw.records,draw.group)} else {
        let records=ctx.device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {label:Some("bounded cloud draw records"),size:16,usage:wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE|wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,mapped_at_creation:false});
        let group=resource_group(ctx,&self.columns_layout,"cloud source and records",[(0,records.as_entire_binding()),(1,columns.positions.as_entire_binding()),(2,columns.colors.as_entire_binding()),(3,columns.normals.as_entire_binding())]);(records,group)
      };
      let id=row.id;draws.push(Draw {row,columns,records,group,visible:scene.visible(id),pickable:scene.pick_id(id.value()).is_some(),selected:selected.contains(&id),color:scene.face_rgba(id),total:0});
    }
    self.draws = draws;
    self.revision = self.revision.wrapping_add(1);
    self.key = None;
    Ok(())
  }
  fn records(
    &mut self,
    ctx: &GpuCtx,
    transform: [f32; 16],
    size: [u32; 2],
    density: f32,
    view: View,
  ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    let mut total = 0u64;
    let mut records_used = 0usize;
    let mut walk = LodWalk::default();
    for draw in &mut self.draws {
      draw.total = 0;
      if !draw.visible {
        continue;
      }
      let row = &draw.row;
      let model=crate::render_space::placed(&row.model,view.anchor).to_f32();
      let projection = Projection {
        eye: view.eye,
        ortho_h: view.ortho_h,
        height_px: size[1],
        lod_px: if row.controls_visible {0.} else {view.lod_px},
        nodes: &row.nodes,
      };
      walk.select(&projection, &row.descriptor, &model);
      walk.ranges.retain_mut(|range| {let start=range.first.max(row.rows.start);let end=(range.first+range.count).min(row.rows.end);range.first=start;range.count=end.saturating_sub(start);range.count>0});
      records_used += walk.ranges.len();
      if records_used > MAX_RECORDS {
        return Err("Cloud view exceeds the 4096-record budget");
      }
      let (bytes, count) = record_bytes(draw, transform, density, view, &walk.ranges)?;
      draw.total = count;
      if bytes.len() as u64 > draw.records.size() {
        let capacity = walk.ranges.len().next_power_of_two().min(MAX_RECORDS);
        draw.records = ctx.device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
          label: Some("bounded cloud draw records"),
          size: 16 + 160 * capacity as u64,
          usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
          mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        draw.group = resource_group(
          ctx,
          &self.columns_layout,
          "cloud source and records",
          [
            (0, draw.records.as_entire_binding()),
            (1, draw.columns.positions.as_entire_binding()),
            (2, draw.columns.colors.as_entire_binding()),
            (3, draw.columns.normals.as_entire_binding()),
          ],
        );
      }
      ctx.queue.write_buffer(&draw.records, 0, &bytes);
      total += draw.total as u64;
    }
    self.total = total;
    Ok(())
  }
  fn render_points(&self, ctx: &GpuCtx, size: [u32; 2]) {
    let settings = [1., size[0] as f32, size[1] as f32, self.edl, 0., 0., 0., 0., size[0] as f32, size[1] as f32, 0., 0.];
    ctx.queue.write_buffer(&self.settings, 0, &settings.into_iter().flat_map(f32::to_ne_bytes).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    let t = self.targets.as_ref().unwrap();
    let mut encoder = ctx.device.create_command_encoder(&Default::default());
    {
      let color = |view| {
        Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
          view,
          depth_slice: None,
          resolve_target: None,
          ops: wgpu::Operations { load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::TRANSPARENT), store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store },
        })
      };
      let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
        label: Some("cached original cloud discs"),
        color_attachments: &[color(&t.color.view), color(&t.ids.view)],
        depth_stencil_attachment: Some(wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
          view: &t.depth.view,
          depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations { load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(crate::depth::FAR as f32), store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store }),
          stencil_ops: None,
        }),
        ..Default::default()
      });
      pass.set_pipeline(&self.point);
      pass.set_bind_group(2,&self.clipping,&[]);
      pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.settings_group, &[]);
      for draw in &self.draws {
        if draw.total > 0 {
          pass.set_bind_group(1, &draw.group, &[]);
          pass.draw(0..6 * draw.total, 0..1);
        }
      }
    }
    ctx.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
  }
  pub fn prepare(
    &mut self,
    ctx: &GpuCtx,
    transform: [f32; 16],
    size: [u32; 2],
    density: f32,
    view: View,
  ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    let key = Key {
      anchor:view.anchor.map(f64::to_bits),
      transform,
      size,
      density: density.to_bits(),
      eye: view.eye.map(f32::to_bits),
      ortho: view.ortho_h.to_bits(),
      lod: view.lod_px.to_bits(),
      revision: self.revision,clipping:self.clip_revision,
    };
    if self.key.as_ref() == Some(&key) {
      self.skips += 1;
      return Ok(());
    }
    self.records(ctx, transform, size, density, view)?;
    if self.targets.as_ref().is_none_or(|t| t.size != size) {
      let color = Image::new(&ctx.device, size, wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm, 4);
      let depth = Image::new(&ctx.device, size, crate::depth::FORMAT, 4);
      let ids = Image::new(&ctx.device, size, wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg32Uint, 8);
      let group = resource_group(
        ctx,
        &self.image_layout,
        "cached cloud pixels",
        [
          (0, wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&depth.view)),
          (1, wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&color.view)),
          (2, wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&ids.view)),
        ],
      );
      self.targets = Some(Targets { color, depth, ids, size, group });
    }
    self.set_samples(ctx,self.samples);
    self.render_points(ctx, size);
    self.key = Some(key);
    self.preparations += 1;
    Ok(())
  }
  pub fn failed(&mut self) {
    self.targets = None;
    self.key = None;
    self.total = 0;
  }
  pub fn draw(&self, pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>) {
    let Some(t) = &self.targets else {
      return;
    };
    pass.set_pipeline(&self.resolve.active);
    pass.set_bind_group(0, &t.group, &[]);
    pass.set_bind_group(1, &self.window_group, &[]);
    pass.set_bind_group(2,&self.settings_group,&[]);
    pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
  }
  pub fn pick(
    &self,
    ctx: &GpuCtx,
    pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>,
    window: crate::pick_window::Window,
    mode: crate::pick_sources::Mode,
  ) {
    let Some(t) = &self.targets else {
      return;
    };
    let words = [window.draw[0], window.draw[1], mode as u32, 0];
    ctx.queue.write_buffer(&self.window, 0, &words.into_iter().flat_map(u32::to_ne_bytes).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    pass.set_pipeline(&self.pick);
    pass.set_bind_group(0, &t.group, &[]);
    pass.set_bind_group(1, &self.window_group, &[]);
    pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
  }
  pub fn usage(&self) -> [u64; 5] {
    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    let columns =
      self.draws.iter().filter(|d| seen.insert(Rc::as_ptr(&d.columns))).map(|d| d.columns.bytes()).sum::<u64>();
    let targets = self.targets.as_ref().map_or(0, |t| t.color.bytes + t.depth.bytes + t.ids.bytes);
    [
      self.total,
      columns
        + self.draws.iter().map(|d| d.records.size()).sum::<u64>()
        + targets
        + self.settings.size()
        + self.window.size(),
      self.uploads,
      self.preparations,
      self.skips,
    ]
  }
}
fn pipeline(
  device: &wgpu::Device,
  shader: &wgpu::ShaderModule,
  groups: &[&wgpu::BindGroupLayout],
  vertex: &str,
  fragment: &str,
  formats: &[wgpu::TextureFormat],
  samples:u32,
) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
  let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
    label: Some(fragment),
    bind_group_layouts: &groups.iter().map(|g| Some(*g)).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    immediate_size: 0,
  });
  device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
    label: Some(fragment),
    layout: Some(&layout),
    vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
      module: shader,
      entry_point: Some(vertex),
      buffers: &[],
      compilation_options: Default::default(),
    },
    fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
      module: shader,
      entry_point: Some(fragment),
      targets: &formats.iter().copied().map(|format| Some(format.into())).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
      compilation_options: Default::default(),
    }),
    primitive: Default::default(),
    depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
      format: crate::depth::FORMAT,
      depth_write_enabled: Some(true),
      depth_compare: Some(crate::depth::CLOSER_EQUAL),
      stencil: Default::default(),
      bias: Default::default(),
    }),
    multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState {count:samples,..Default::default()},
    multiview_mask: None,
    cache: None,
  })
}

struct Layouts {
  uniform: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
  window: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
  columns: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
  image: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}
fn layouts(ctx: &GpuCtx) -> Layouts {
  let uniform = crate::gpu_layout::uniform(&ctx.device, 48);
  let window_layout = crate::gpu_layout::uniform(&ctx.device, 16);
  let storage = |binding| wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    binding,
    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX,
    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
      ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
      has_dynamic_offset: false,
      min_binding_size: None,
    },
    count: None,
  };
  let columns_layout = ctx.device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
    label: Some("cloud source columns and bounded records"),
    entries: &[storage(0), storage(1), storage(2), storage(3)],
  });
  let texture = |binding, sample_type| {
    crate::text_gpu_support::texture_entry(binding, wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT, sample_type, false)
  };
  let image_layout = ctx.device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
    label: Some("cached cloud images"),
    entries: &[
      texture(0, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth),
      texture(1, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: false }),
      texture(2, wgpu::TextureSampleType::Uint),
    ],
  });
  Layouts { uniform, window: window_layout, columns: columns_layout, image: image_layout }
}
fn pipelines(ctx: &GpuCtx, format: wgpu::TextureFormat, layouts: &Layouts) -> ([wgpu::RenderPipeline; 3],wgpu::ShaderModule) {
  let shader = ctx.device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
    label: Some("current production cloud discs"),
    source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(crate::clipping_gpu::source(include_str!("cloud_points.wgsl"),2,0).into()),
  });
  let resolver = ctx.device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
    label: Some("forward-depth cloud resolve"),
    source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(include_str!("cloud_resolve.wgsl").into()),
  });
  let point = pipeline(
    &ctx.device,
    &shader,
    &[&layouts.uniform, &layouts.columns,&crate::clipping_gpu::layout(&ctx.device)],
    "vs_point",
    "fs_point",
    &[wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm, wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg32Uint],
    1,
  );
  let resolve = pipeline(&ctx.device, &resolver, &[&layouts.image, &layouts.window, &layouts.uniform], "vertex", "color", &[format,crate::primitive_image::FORMAT],1);
  let pick = pipeline(
    &ctx.device,
    &resolver,
    &[&layouts.image, &layouts.window],
    "vertex",
    "pick",
    &[wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg32Uint,crate::primitive_image::FORMAT],
    1,
  );
  ([point, resolve, pick],resolver)
}

fn record_bytes(
  draw: &Draw,
  transform: [f32; 16],
  density: f32,
  view: View,
  ranges: &[crate::cloud_lod::Range],
) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, u32), &'static str> {
  let row = &draw.row;
  let local=crate::render_space::placed(&row.model,view.anchor);
  let model=local.to_f32();
  let scale = row.model.uniform_scale();
  let mut total = 0u32;
  let m=(&session_rust::Xform::from_matrix(transform.map(f64::from))*&local).to_f32();
  let rot = [
    model[0], model[1], model[2], model[12], model[4], model[5], model[6], model[13], model[8], model[9], model[10],
    model[14],
  ];
  let rgb = draw.color.map_or([1., 1., 1.], |c| [c[0],c[1],c[2]]);
  let px = row.point_px;
  let flags = u32::from(draw.selected) | if draw.color.is_some() { 256 } else { 0 };
  let instance = if draw.pickable { row.id.value() - 1 } else { u32::MAX };
  let mut bytes = vec![0; 16];
  for range in ranges {
    let cumulative = total;
    total = total
      .checked_add(range.count)
      .filter(|n| *n <= u32::MAX / 6)
      .ok_or("Cloud vertex count exceeds the draw limit")?;
    let words = m
      .map(f32::to_bits)
      .into_iter()
      .chain([rgb[0].to_bits(), rgb[1].to_bits(), rgb[2].to_bits(), (px * density * 0.5).max(0.5).to_bits()])
      .chain([range.first-row.rows.start, range.count, cumulative, radius_factor(range, px, scale, view.ortho_h).to_bits()])
      .chain(rot.map(f32::to_bits))
      .chain([if draw.columns.has_normals { range.first-row.rows.start } else { u32::MAX }, instance, flags, row.address]);
    bytes.extend(words.flat_map(u32::to_ne_bytes));
  }
  bytes[..4].copy_from_slice(&(ranges.len() as u32).to_ne_bytes());
  bytes[4..8].copy_from_slice(&total.to_ne_bytes());
  Ok((bytes, total))
}

pub fn radius_factor(range: &crate::cloud_lod::Range, px: f32, scale: f64, ortho_h: f32) -> f32 {
  crate::cloud_lod::radius_factor(range, px, scale, ortho_h) * if ortho_h > 0. { 1. } else { 1000. }
}
```

```rust
use crate::{
    scene::{ObjectId, Scene},
    sheet_source::Prepared,
};
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    rc::{Rc, Weak},
};
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;
struct Geometry {
    _page: crate::sheet_stream::DisplayPage,
    source: Rc<Prepared>,
    vertices: wgpu::Buffer,
    count: u32,
}
struct Draw {
    id: ObjectId,
    geometry: Rc<Geometry>,
    uniform: wgpu::Buffer,
    group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    bytes: Vec<u8>,
}
pub struct Lane {
    projection: std::cell::Cell<Option<f32>>,
    pipeline:crate::sample_pipelines::Variants<wgpu::RenderPipeline>,
    format:wgpu::TextureFormat,samples:u32,
    pick: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    view: wgpu::Buffer,
    group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    draws: Vec<Draw>,
    cache: HashMap<(usize, u32), Weak<Geometry>>,
    pub uploads: u64,
    pub uploaded_bytes: u64,
}
impl Lane {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, format: wgpu::TextureFormat) -> Self {
        let (pipeline, pick) = crate::sheet_pipeline::pipelines(device, format);
        let view = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("sheet view"),
            size: 80,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        let group = crate::gpu_layout::group(device, &pipeline.get_bind_group_layout(0), &view);
        Self {
            projection: Default::default(),
            pipeline:crate::sample_pipelines::Variants::new(pipeline,1),format,samples:1,
            pick,
            view,
            group,
            draws: Vec::new(),
            cache: HashMap::new(),
            uploads: 0,
            uploaded_bytes: 0,
        }
    }
    fn geometry(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        source: &Rc<Prepared>,
        page: crate::sheet_stream::DisplayPage,
        rows: std::ops::Range<u32>,
    ) -> Result<Rc<Geometry>, &'static str> {
        let key = (page.key(), rows.start);
        Ok(
            if let Some(owner) = self.cache.get(&key).and_then(Weak::upgrade) {
                owner
            } else {
                let count = rows.end - rows.start;
                if count as u64 * 32 > device.limits().max_buffer_size {
                    return Err("Sheet display exceeds the device buffer limit");
                }
                let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(count as usize * 32);
                for (i, p) in page
                    .display
                    .chunks_exact(6)
                    .enumerate()
                    .skip(rows.start as usize)
                    .take(count as usize)
                {
                    for v in &p[..3] {
                        bytes.extend(v.to_le_bytes());
                    }
                    bytes.extend(page.radius(i).to_le_bytes());
                    for v in &p[3..] {
                        bytes.extend(v.to_le_bytes());
                    }
                    bytes.extend(page.colors[i].to_le_bytes());
                }
                let vertices = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
                    label: Some("shared original sheet segments"),
                    contents: &bytes,
                    usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX,
                });
                self.uploads += 1;
                self.uploaded_bytes += bytes.len() as u64;
                let owner = Rc::new(Geometry {
                    _page: page.clone(),
                    source: source.clone(),
                    vertices,
                    count,
                });
                self.cache.insert(key, Rc::downgrade(&owner));
                owner
            },
        )
    }
    pub fn set(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        scene: &Scene,
        selected: &[ObjectId],
        bases: &HashMap<(ObjectId, usize), u32>,
    ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        self.set_anchored(device,queue,scene,selected,bases,[0.;3])
    }
    pub fn set_anchored(&mut self,device:&wgpu::Device,queue:&wgpu::Queue,scene:&Scene,selected:&[ObjectId],bases:&HashMap<(ObjectId,usize),u32>,anchor:[f64;3])->Result<(),&'static str>{
        let mut old = std::mem::take(&mut self.draws);
        for row in scene
            .sheets()
            .iter()
            .filter(|row| scene.visible(row.id) && row.prepared.original.segment_count > 0)
        {
            for page in row.prepared.pages() {
                for rows in chunks(
                    page.rows.end - page.rows.start,
                    device.limits().max_buffer_size,
                )? {
                    let key = page.key();
                    let geometry =
                        self.geometry(device, &row.prepared, page.clone(), rows.clone())?;
                    let base = bases
                        .get(&(row.id, key))
                        .ok_or("Missing sheet original entity addresses")?
                        .checked_add(rows.start)
                        .ok_or("Drawing pick address overflow")?;
                    let bytes = settings(scene, row, base, selected.contains(&row.id),anchor);
                    let draw = if let Some(i) = old
                        .iter()
                        .position(|d| d.id == row.id && Rc::ptr_eq(&d.geometry, &geometry))
                    {
                        let mut draw = old.swap_remove(i);
                        if draw.bytes != bytes {
                            queue.write_buffer(&draw.uniform, 0, &bytes);
                            draw.bytes = bytes;
                        }
                        draw
                    } else {
                        let uniform =
                            device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
                                label: Some("independent sheet placement"),
                                contents: &bytes,
                                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                            });
                        let group = crate::gpu_layout::group(
                            device,
                            &self.pipeline.active.get_bind_group_layout(1),
                            &uniform,
                        );
                        Draw {
                            id: row.id,
                            geometry,
                            uniform,
                            group,
                            bytes,
                        }
                    };
                    self.draws.push(draw);
                }
            }
        }
        drop(old);
        self.cache.retain(|_, owner| owner.strong_count() > 0);
        self.set_samples(device,self.samples);
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn camera(&self, camera: &crate::camera::Camera) {
        let lens = 1.0 / std::f64::consts::FRAC_PI_6.tan();
        let lens = match camera.projection {
            crate::camera::Projection::Perspective => lens,
            crate::camera::Projection::Orthographic => lens / camera.distance,
        };
        self.projection.set(Some(lens as f32));
    }
    pub fn view(&self, queue: &wgpu::Queue, transform: &[f32; 16], size: [u32; 2], density: f32) {
        let projection_y = self.projection.get().unwrap_or_else(|| {
            (transform[1] * transform[1]
                + transform[5] * transform[5]
                + transform[9] * transform[9])
                .sqrt()
        });
        let bytes = transform
            .iter()
            .copied()
            .chain([size[0] as f32, size[1] as f32, density, projection_y])
            .flat_map(f32::to_le_bytes)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        queue.write_buffer(&self.view, 0, &bytes);
    }
    pub fn set_samples(&mut self,device:&wgpu::Device,samples:u32) {
        assert!(matches!(samples,1|4));self.samples=samples;if self.draws.is_empty(){return;}
        self.pipeline.select(samples,||crate::sheet_pipeline::colour(device,self.format,samples));
    }
    pub fn draw(&self, pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>) {
        if self.draws.is_empty(){return;}

        pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline.active);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.group, &[]);
        for draw in &self.draws {
            pass.set_bind_group(1, &draw.group, &[]);
            pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, draw.geometry.vertices.slice(..));
            pass.draw(0..6, 0..draw.geometry.count);
        }
    }
    pub fn pick(&self, pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>, crop: &wgpu::BindGroup,clipping:&wgpu::BindGroup) {
        if self.draws.is_empty(){return;}
        pass.set_pipeline(&self.pick);
        pass.set_bind_group(3,clipping,&[]);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.group, &[]);
        pass.set_bind_group(2, crop, &[]);
        for draw in &self.draws {
            pass.set_bind_group(1, &draw.group, &[]);
            pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, draw.geometry.vertices.slice(..));
            pass.draw(0..6, 0..draw.geometry.count);
        }
    }
    pub fn usage(&self) -> [u64; 5] {
        let mut unique = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        let bytes = self
            .draws
            .iter()
            .filter(|d| unique.insert(Rc::as_ptr(&d.geometry)))
            .map(|d| d.geometry.vertices.size())
            .sum::<u64>();
        [
            self.draws.len() as u64,
            unique.len() as u64,
            bytes + self.draws.len() as u64 * 96 + 80,
            self.uploads,
            self.uploaded_bytes,
        ]
    }
    pub fn sources(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Rc<Prepared>> {
        self.draws.iter().map(|draw| &draw.geometry.source)
    }
}

pub fn chunks(count: u32, bytes: u64) -> Result<Vec<std::ops::Range<u32>>, &'static str> {
    let size = u32::try_from((bytes / 32).min(u64::from(u32::MAX)))
        .map_err(|_| "Drawing buffer range overflow")?;
    if size == 0 {
        return Err("Device cannot hold one drawing segment");
    }
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut from = 0;
    while from < count {
        let to = from + size.min(count - from);
        out.push(from..to);
        from = to;
    }
    Ok(out)
}

        assert_eq!(super::chunks(10, 128).unwrap(), vec![0..4, 4..8, 8..10]);
        assert!(super::chunks(1, 31).is_err());
        assert!(super::chunks(0, 32).unwrap().is_empty());
    }

fn settings(scene: &Scene, row: &crate::sheet_source::Row, base: u32, selected: bool,anchor:[f64;3]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut bytes = crate::render_space::placed(&row.model,anchor)
        .m
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|v| (*v as f32).to_le_bytes())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    bytes.extend(
        scene
            .face_rgba(row.id)
            .unwrap_or([0.; 4])
            .into_iter()
            .flat_map(f32::to_le_bytes),
    );
    bytes.extend(
        [
            scene.pick_id(row.id.value()).map_or(0, ObjectId::value),
            base,
            u32::from(selected),
            0,
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .flat_map(u32::to_le_bytes),
    );
    bytes
}
```

```rust
pub fn make(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    layout: &wgpu::PipelineLayout,
    shader: &wgpu::ShaderModule,
    vertex: &str,
    fragment: &str,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    blend: Option<wgpu::BlendState>,
    samples:u32,
) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
    device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {label:Some("sheet batch"),layout:Some(layout),vertex:wgpu::VertexState {module:shader,entry_point:Some(vertex),compilation_options:Default::default(),buffers:&[wgpu::VertexBufferLayout {array_stride:32,step_mode:wgpu::VertexStepMode::Instance,attributes:&wgpu::vertex_attr_array![0=>Float32x3,1=>Float32,2=>Float32x3,3=>Uint32]}]},fragment:Some(wgpu::FragmentState {module:shader,entry_point:Some(fragment),compilation_options:Default::default(),targets:&[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {format,blend,write_mask:wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL})]}),primitive:Default::default(),depth_stencil:Some(crate::depth::ink()),multisample:wgpu::MultisampleState{count:samples,..Default::default()},multiview_mask:None,cache:None})
}

pub fn pipelines(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
) -> (wgpu::RenderPipeline, wgpu::RenderPipeline) {
    let view_layout = crate::gpu_layout::uniform(device, 80);
    let model_layout = crate::gpu_layout::uniform(device, 96);
    let crop_layout = crate::gpu_layout::uniform(device, 80);
    let expanded=crate::finite_project_source::expand(include_str!("sheet.wgsl"));
    let source=expanded.as_str();
    let clip_layout=crate::clipping_gpu::layout(device);
    let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
        label: Some("sheet pens"),
        source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(crate::clipping_gpu::source(source,2,0).into()),
    });
    let pick_shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
        label: Some("sheet original entities"),
        source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(
            crate::clipping_gpu::source(&format!(
                "{source}\n{}\n{}",
                include_str!("pick_crop.wgsl"),
                include_str!("sheet_pick.wgsl")
            ),3,0)
            .into(),
        ),
    });
    let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("sheet pens"),
        bind_group_layouts: &[Some(&view_layout), Some(&model_layout),Some(&clip_layout)],
        immediate_size: 0,
    });
    let pick_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("sheet entity picks"),
        bind_group_layouts: &[Some(&view_layout), Some(&model_layout), Some(&crop_layout),Some(&clip_layout)],
        immediate_size: 0,
    });
    let pipeline = make(
        device,
        &layout,
        &shader,
        "vertex",
        "fragment",
        format,
        Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING),
        1,
    );
    let pick = make(
        device,
        &pick_layout,
        &pick_shader,
        "pick_vertex",
        "pick_fragment",
        wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg32Uint,
        None,
        1,
    );
    (pipeline, pick)
}
```

```rust
fn pipeline(ctx: &GpuCtx, target: Target, ids: bool) -> Pipeline {
    let device = ctx.device.clone();
    let pick = crate::gpu_layout::uniform(&ctx.device,80);
    {
        let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
            label: Some("text plate shader"),
            source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(if target.samples==4 {include_str!("text_plate.wgsl").replace("@location(0) local:","@location(0) @interpolate(linear,sample) local:").into()}else{include_str!("text_plate.wgsl").into()}),
        });
        let id_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("text plate ids"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[Some(&pick)],
            immediate_size: 0,
        });
        device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("text plates"),
            layout: if ids { Some(&id_layout) } else { None },
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: Some(if ids { "vs_id" } else { "vs_main" }),
                buffers: &[wgpu::VertexBufferLayout {
                    array_stride: 40,
                    step_mode: wgpu::VertexStepMode::Vertex,
                    attributes: &wgpu::vertex_attr_array![0 => Float32x3, 1 => Float32x2, 2 => Float32x2, 3 => Float32, 4 => Uint32, 5 => Float32],
                }],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: Some(if ids { "fs_id" } else { "fs_main" }),
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: target.format,
                    blend: if ids { None } else { Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING) },
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: Default::default(),
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
                depth_write_enabled: Some(false),
                depth_compare: Some(crate::depth::CLOSER_EQUAL),
                stencil: Default::default(),
                bias: Default::default(),
            }),
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState {
                count: target.samples,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            multiview_mask: None,
            cache: None,
        })
    }
}

impl Plates {
    pub(super) fn new(ctx: &GpuCtx, target: Target) -> Self {
        Self {
            vertices: GrowBuf::new(ctx, "text.plates", 40, VERTS),
            pipeline:Variants::new(pipeline(ctx,target,false),target.samples),format:target.format,
            id_pipeline: pipeline(ctx, Target::ID, true),
            physical_vertices: 0,
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn retarget(&mut self, ctx: &GpuCtx, target: Target) {
        if target.format!=self.format {self.pipeline=Variants::new(pipeline(ctx,target,false),target.samples);self.format=target.format;}
        else {self.pipeline.select(target.samples,||pipeline(ctx,target,false));}
    }

    pub(super) fn draw(&self, pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>, overlay: bool) -> u32 {
        let range = if overlay {
            self.physical_vertices..self.vertices.len()
        } else {
            0..self.physical_vertices
        };

        if range.is_empty() {
            return 0;
        }

        pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline.active);
        pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, self.vertices.buf.slice(..));
        pass.draw(range, 0..1);
        1
    }

    pub(super) fn draw_ids(
        &self,
        pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>,
        pick_transform: &wgpu::BindGroup,
    ) -> u32 {
        if self.vertices.is_empty() {
            return 0;
        }

        pass.set_pipeline(&self.id_pipeline);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, pick_transform, &[]);
        pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, self.vertices.buf.slice(..));
        pass.draw(0..self.vertices.len(), 0..1);
        1
    }

    pub(super) fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.vertices.reset();
        self.physical_vertices = 0;
    }

    pub(super) fn release(&mut self, ctx: &GpuCtx) {
        self.vertices.release(ctx);
    }

    pub(super) fn allocated_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.vertices.buf.size()
    }
}

impl Plates {

    pub(super) fn prepare(&mut self, ctx: &GpuCtx, rectangles: &[Rectangle], size: [u32; 2]) {
        self.vertices.reset();
        let mut vertices = Vec::with_capacity(rectangles.len() * 6);
        self.physical_vertices = 0;

        for overlay in [false, true] {
            for rectangle in rectangles {
                if rectangle.depth.is_none() != overlay {
                    continue;
                }

                let [left, top, right, bottom] = rectangle.bounds;
                let half = [(right - left) * 0.5, (bottom - top) * 0.5];
                let center = [(left + right) * 0.5, (top + bottom) * 0.5];
                let radius = if rectangle.rounded {
                    half[0].min(half[1]).max(0.0)
                } else {
                    0.0
                };
                let left = left.max(rectangle.clip[0]);
                let top = top.max(rectangle.clip[1]);
                let right = right.min(rectangle.clip[2]);
                let bottom = bottom.min(rectangle.clip[3]);

                if right <= left || bottom <= top {
                    continue;
                }

                for [x, y] in [
                    [left, top],
                    [left, bottom],
                    [right, bottom],
                    [left, top],
                    [right, bottom],
                    [right, top],
                ] {
                    vertices.push([
                        2.0 * x / size[0] as f32 - 1.0,
                        1.0 - 2.0 * y / size[1] as f32,
                        rectangle.depth.unwrap_or(crate::depth::NEAR as f32),
                        x - center[0],
                        y - center[1],
                        half[0],
                        half[1],
                        radius,
                        f32::from_bits(rectangle.object.map_or(0, |object| object.row.wrapping_add(1))),
                        if rectangle.object.is_some_and(|object| object.selected) {
                            1.0
                        } else {
                            0.0
                        },
                    ]);
                }
            }

            if !overlay {
                self.physical_vertices = vertices.len() as u32;
            }
        }

        self.vertices.append(ctx, &vertices);
    }
}
```

```rust
use super::TextFrame;
use crate::text::{TextDocument, TextLabel, TextPlacement, TextRun};
use crate::text_gpu_support::resource_group;
use crate::text_gpu_support::texture_entry;
use crate::text_gpu_support::{GpuCtx, GrowBuf, VERTS};
use crate::text_gpu_support::{Pipeline, Target};
use glyphon::{FontSystem, SwashCache, SwashContent};
use wgpu::{ShaderStages, TextureSampleType};

const TEXTURE_BUDGET: u64 = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
struct CachedPlane {
    label: TextLabel,
    font_revision: u64,
    em_pixels: u32,
    size: [u32; 2],
    extent: [f32; 4],
    texture: wgpu::Texture,
    bind: wgpu::BindGroup,
}
impl Drop for CachedPlane {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.texture.destroy();
    }
}
pub(super) struct Planes {
    cached: Vec<CachedPlane>,
    draws: Vec<(usize, u32)>,
    vertices: GrowBuf,
    layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    sampler: wgpu::Sampler,
    pipeline:crate::sample_pipelines::Variants<Pipeline>,
    id_pipeline: Pipeline,
    target: Target,
    pub(super) rasterizations: u64,
}

fn same_raster(cached: &CachedPlane, label: &TextLabel, revision: u64, em_pixels: u32) -> bool {
    cached.font_revision == revision
        && cached.label.text == label.text
        && cached.label.font_size == label.font_size
        && cached.label.line_height == label.line_height
        && cached.em_pixels >= em_pixels
}

fn project(world: [f64; 3], frame: &TextFrame) -> [f32; 4] {
    let point = [
        (world[0] - frame.origin[0]) as f32,
        (world[1] - frame.origin[1]) as f32,
        (world[2] - frame.origin[2]) as f32,
        1.0,
    ];
    let mut clip = [0.0; 4];

    for (row, out) in clip.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        for (column, value) in point.iter().enumerate() {
            *out += frame.mvp[column * 4 + row] * value;
        }
    }

    clip
}

fn raster_em(label: &TextLabel, frame: &TextFrame) -> u32 {
    let TextPlacement::WorldPlane {
        world,
        right,
        up,
        world_height,
        ..
    } = label.placement
    else {
        return 32;
    };
    let a = project(world, frame);

    if a[3] <= 0.0 {
        return 32;
    }

    let mut projected_em = 0.0f32;

    for direction in [right, up] {
        let mut end = world;

        for axis in 0..3 {
            end[axis] += direction[axis] * world_height;
        }

        let b = project(end, frame);

        if b[3] <= 0.0 {
            continue;
        }

        let x = (a[0] / a[3] - b[0] / b[3]) * frame.framebuffer[0] as f32 * 0.5;
        let y = (a[1] / a[3] - b[1] / b[3]) * frame.framebuffer[1] as f32 * 0.5;
        projected_em = projected_em.max(x.hypot(y));
    }

    let needed = (projected_em * 2.0).clamp(32.0, 256.0);
    let mut bucket = 32;

    while (bucket as f32) < needed {
        bucket *= 2;
    }

    bucket
}

fn fitting_em(run: &TextRun) -> u32 {
    let mut size = 0.0f32;

    for line in run.buffer.layout_runs() {
        size = size.max(line.line_w).max(line.line_top + line.line_height);
    }

    let ems = size / run.label.font_size + 3.0;
    let mut em = 256;

    while em > 32 && ems * em as f32 > 4000.0 {
        em /= 2;
    }

    em
}

fn coverage(content: &SwashContent, data: &[u8], source: usize) -> u8 {
    match content {
        SwashContent::Mask => data[source],
        SwashContent::Color => data[source * 4 + 3],
        SwashContent::SubpixelMask => {
            ((u16::from(data[source * 4])
                + u16::from(data[source * 4 + 1])
                + u16::from(data[source * 4 + 2]))
                / 3) as u8
        }
    }
}

fn rasterize(
    run: &TextRun,
    fonts: &mut FontSystem,
    raster: &mut SwashCache,
    em_pixels: u32,
) -> anyhow::Result<(Vec<u8>, [u32; 2], [f32; 4])> {
    let scale = em_pixels as f32 / run.label.font_size;
    let mut glyphs = Vec::new();
    let mut bounds = [0i32; 4];

    for line in run.buffer.layout_runs() {
        bounds[2] = bounds[2].max((line.line_w * scale).ceil() as i32);
        bounds[3] = bounds[3].max(((line.line_top + line.line_height) * scale).ceil() as i32);
        anyhow::ensure!(
            bounds[2] <= 4092 && bounds[3] <= 4092,
            "world text layout exceeds 4096px extent"
        );

        for glyph in line.glyphs {
            let physical = glyph.physical((0.0, 0.0), scale);
            let Some(image) = raster.get_image(fonts, physical.cache_key) else {
                continue;
            };
            let x = physical.x + image.placement.left;
            let y = (line.line_y * scale).round() as i32 + physical.y - image.placement.top;
            bounds[0] = bounds[0].min(x);
            bounds[1] = bounds[1].min(y);
            bounds[2] = bounds[2].max(x + image.placement.width as i32);
            bounds[3] = bounds[3].max(y + image.placement.height as i32);
            glyphs.push((physical.cache_key, x, y));
        }
    }

    let vertical_padding = (run.label.font_size * (2.0 / 9.0) * scale).ceil() as i32;
    let horizontal_padding = (bounds[3] - bounds[1] + 2 * vertical_padding + 1) / 2;
    bounds[0] -= horizontal_padding;
    bounds[1] -= vertical_padding;
    bounds[2] += horizontal_padding;
    bounds[3] += vertical_padding;
    let size = [
        (bounds[2] - bounds[0]) as u32,
        (bounds[3] - bounds[1]) as u32,
    ];
    anyhow::ensure!(
        size[0] <= 4096 && size[1] <= 4096,
        "world text texture exceeds 4096px extent"
    );
    let mut pixels = vec![0u8; (size[0] * size[1]) as usize];

    for (key, x, y) in glyphs {
        let Some(image) = raster.get_image(fonts, key) else {
            continue;
        };

        for row in 0..image.placement.height {
            for column in 0..image.placement.width {
                let source = (row * image.placement.width + column) as usize;
                let coverage = coverage(&image.content, &image.data, source);
                let target = ((y - bounds[1] + row as i32) as u32 * size[0]
                    + (x - bounds[0] + column as i32) as u32) as usize;
                let previous = u16::from(pixels[target]);
                pixels[target] = (previous + u16::from(coverage) * (255 - previous) / 255) as u8;
            }
        }
    }

    Ok((
        pixels,
        size,
        [
            bounds[0] as f32 / scale,
            bounds[1] as f32 / scale,
            bounds[2] as f32 / scale,
            bounds[3] as f32 / scale,
        ],
    ))
}

fn upload_plane(
    ctx: &GpuCtx,
    layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
    label: &TextLabel,
    font_revision: u64,
    em_pixels: u32,
    data: (Vec<u8>, [u32; 2], [f32; 4]),
) -> CachedPlane {
    let (pixels, size, extent) = data;
    let texture = ctx.device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("world text coverage"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: size[0],
            height: size[1],
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    ctx.queue.write_texture(
        texture.as_image_copy(),
        &pixels,
        wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
            offset: 0,
            bytes_per_row: Some(size[0]),
            rows_per_image: Some(size[1]),
        },
        texture.size(),
    );
    let view = texture.create_view(&Default::default());
    let bind = resource_group(
        ctx,
        &layout,
        "world text coverage",
        [
            (0, wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&view)),
            (1, wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&sampler)),
        ],
    );
    CachedPlane {
        label: label.clone(),
        font_revision: font_revision,
        em_pixels,
        size,
        extent,
        texture,
        bind,
    }
}

fn append_quad(
    vertices: &mut Vec<[f32; 16]>,
    label: &TextLabel,
    extent: [f32; 4],
    frame: &TextFrame,
    srgb: bool,
) {
    let TextPlacement::WorldPlane {
        world,
        right,
        up,
        world_height,
    } = label.placement
    else {
        return;
    };
    let unit = world_height / f64::from(label.font_size);
    let mut color = [0.0; 4];

    for (index, component) in color.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        let value = f32::from(label.ink_color()[index]) / 255.0;
        *component = if srgb && index < 3 {
            if value <= 0.04045 {
                value / 12.92
            } else {
                ((value + 0.055) / 1.055).powf(2.4)
            }
        } else {
            value
        };
    }

    let scale = frame.framebuffer[0] as f32 / frame.logical[0] as f32;
    let mut bounds = [
        0.0,
        0.0,
        frame.framebuffer[0] as f32,
        frame.framebuffer[1] as f32,
    ];

    if let Some(clip) = label.clip {
        for (index, value) in bounds.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            *value = clip[index] * scale;
        }
    }

    bounds = [
        2.0 * bounds[0] / frame.framebuffer[0] as f32 - 1.0,
        1.0 - 2.0 * bounds[3] / frame.framebuffer[1] as f32,
        2.0 * bounds[2] / frame.framebuffer[0] as f32 - 1.0,
        1.0 - 2.0 * bounds[1] / frame.framebuffer[1] as f32,
    ];
    for [u, v] in [
        [0.0, 0.0],
        [0.0, 1.0],
        [1.0, 1.0],
        [0.0, 0.0],
        [1.0, 1.0],
        [1.0, 0.0],
    ] {
        let x = f64::from(extent[0] + (extent[2] - extent[0]) * u) * unit;
        let y = f64::from(extent[1] + (extent[3] - extent[1]) * v) * unit;
        let mut point = world;

        for axis in 0..3 {
            point[axis] += right[axis] * x - up[axis] * y;
        }

        let clip = project(point, frame);
        vertices.push([
            clip[0],
            clip[1],
            clip[2],
            clip[3],
            u,
            v,
            color[0],
            color[1],
            color[2],
            color[3],
            bounds[0],
            bounds[1],
            bounds[2],
            bounds[3],
            f32::from_bits(label.object.map_or(0, |object| object.row.wrapping_add(1))),
            if label.object.is_some_and(|object| object.selected) {
                1.0
            } else {
                0.0
            },
        ]);
    }
}

fn pipeline(ctx: &GpuCtx, target: Target, layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout, ids: bool) -> Pipeline {
    let device = ctx.device.clone();
    let layout = layout.clone();
    let pick = crate::gpu_layout::uniform(&ctx.device, 80);
    {
        let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
            label: Some("world text shader"),
            source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(if target.samples==4 {include_str!("text_plane.wgsl").replace("@location(0) uv:","@location(0) @interpolate(perspective,sample) uv:").replace("@location(1) color:","@location(1) @interpolate(perspective,sample) color:").replace("@location(5) original:","@location(5) @interpolate(perspective,sample) original:").into()}else{include_str!("text_plane.wgsl").into()}),
        });
        let colour_groups = [Some(&layout)];
        let id_groups = [Some(&layout), Some(&pick)];
        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("world text"),
            bind_group_layouts: if ids { &id_groups } else { &colour_groups },
            immediate_size: 0,
        });
        device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("world text"), layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState { module: &shader, entry_point: Some(if ids { "vs_id" } else { "vs_main" }), buffers: &[wgpu::VertexBufferLayout { array_stride: 64, step_mode: wgpu::VertexStepMode::Vertex,
                attributes: &wgpu::vertex_attr_array![0 => Float32x4, 1 => Float32x2, 2 => Float32x4, 3 => Float32x4, 4 => Uint32, 5 => Float32] }], compilation_options: Default::default() },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState { module: &shader, entry_point: Some(if ids { "fs_id" } else { "fs_main" }), targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState { format: target.format, blend: if ids { None } else { Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING) }, write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL })], compilation_options: Default::default() }),
            primitive: Default::default(), depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState { format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float, depth_write_enabled: Some(false), depth_compare: Some(crate::depth::CLOSER_EQUAL), stencil: Default::default(), bias: Default::default() }),
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState { count: target.samples, ..Default::default() }, multiview_mask: None, cache: None,
        })
    }
}

impl Planes {

    pub(super) fn new(ctx: &GpuCtx, target: Target) -> Self {
        let layout = ctx
            .device
            .create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
                label: Some("world text texture"),
                entries: &[
                    texture_entry(
                        0,
                        ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                        false,
                    ),
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 1,
                        visibility: ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                        count: None,
                    },
                ],
            });
        let sampler = ctx.device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("world text coverage"),
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            ..Default::default()
        });
        let id_pipeline = pipeline(ctx, Target::ID, &layout, true);
        let pipeline = pipeline(ctx, target, &layout, false);
        Self {
            cached: Vec::new(),
            draws: Vec::new(),
            vertices: GrowBuf::new(ctx, "world text vertices", 64, VERTS),
            layout,
            sampler,
            pipeline:crate::sample_pipelines::Variants::new(pipeline,target.samples),
            id_pipeline,
            target,
            rasterizations: 0,
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn retarget(&mut self, ctx: &GpuCtx, target: Target) {
        if target.format!=self.target.format {self.pipeline=crate::sample_pipelines::Variants::new(pipeline(ctx,target,&self.layout,false),target.samples);}
        else {self.pipeline.select(target.samples,||pipeline(ctx,target,&self.layout,false));}
        self.target=target;
    }

    pub(super) fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.cached.clear();
        self.draws.clear();
        self.vertices.reset();
    }

    pub(super) fn release(&mut self, ctx: &GpuCtx) {
        self.reset();
        self.vertices.release(ctx);
    }

    pub(super) fn buffer_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.vertices.buf.size()
    }

    pub(super) fn texture_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        let mut total = 0;

        for cached in &self.cached {
            total += u64::from(cached.size[0]) * u64::from(cached.size[1]);
        }

        total
    }
}

impl Planes {
    fn cached_plane(
        &mut self,
        ctx: &GpuCtx,
        run: &TextRun,
        fonts: &mut FontSystem,
        raster: &mut SwashCache,
        font_revision: u64,
        em_pixels: u32,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<usize> {
        let mut index = None;

        for (at, cached) in self.cached.iter().enumerate() {
            if cached.label.id == run.label.id {
                index = Some(at);
                break;
            }
        }

        let rebuild = match index {
            Some(at) => !same_raster(&self.cached[at], &run.label, font_revision, em_pixels),
            None => true,
        };

        if rebuild {
            let (pixels, size, extent) = rasterize(run, fonts, raster, em_pixels)?;
            let mut allocated = u64::from(size[0]) * u64::from(size[1]);

            for (at, cached) in self.cached.iter().enumerate() {
                if Some(at) != index {
                    allocated += u64::from(cached.size[0]) * u64::from(cached.size[1]);
                }
            }

            anyhow::ensure!(
                allocated <= TEXTURE_BUDGET,
                "world text coverage exceeds 32 MiB budget"
            );
            let cached = upload_plane(
                ctx,
                &self.layout,
                &self.sampler,
                &run.label,
                font_revision,
                em_pixels,
                (pixels, size, extent),
            );

            match index {
                Some(at) => self.cached[at] = cached,
                None => {
                    index = Some(self.cached.len());
                    self.cached.push(cached);
                }
            }

            self.rasterizations += 1;

            if raster.image_cache.len() > 4096 {
                *raster = SwashCache::new();
            }
        }

        Ok(index.expect("a prepared world plane has a cache entry"))
    }
}

impl Planes {

    pub(super) fn prepare(
        &mut self,
        ctx: &GpuCtx,
        document: &mut TextDocument,
        raster: &mut SwashCache,
        frame: &TextFrame,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        self.draws.clear();
        self.vertices.reset();
        self.cached.retain(|cached| {
            document.runs.iter().any(|run| {
                run.label.id == cached.label.id
                    && matches!(run.label.placement, TextPlacement::WorldPlane { .. })
            })
        });
        let mut vertices = Vec::new();

        for run in &document.runs {
            if !matches!(run.label.placement, TextPlacement::WorldPlane { .. })
                || run.label.text.is_empty()
            {
                continue;
            }

            if let TextPlacement::WorldPlane { world, .. } = run.label.placement
                && frame.cut(world)
            {
                continue;
            }
            let em_pixels = raster_em(&run.label, frame).min(fitting_em(run));
            let index = self.cached_plane(
                ctx,
                run,
                &mut document.fonts,
                raster,
                document.font_revision,
                em_pixels,
            )?;

            let start = vertices.len() as u32;
            append_quad(
                &mut vertices,
                &run.label,
                self.cached[index].extent,
                frame,
                self.target.format.is_srgb(),
            );
            self.draws.push((index, start));
        }

        self.vertices.append(ctx, &vertices);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn draw_run(&self, pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>, pipeline: &Pipeline) -> u32 {
        if self.draws.is_empty() {
            return 0;
        }

        pass.set_pipeline(pipeline);
        pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, self.vertices.buf.slice(..));

        for &(index, start) in &self.draws {
            pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.cached[index].bind, &[]);
            pass.draw(start..start + 6, 0..1);
        }

        self.draws.len() as u32
    }

    pub(super) fn draw(&self, pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>) -> u32 {
        if self.draws.is_empty() {
            return 0;
        }

        self.draw_run(pass, &self.pipeline.active)
    }

    pub(super) fn draw_ids(
        &self,
        pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>,
        pick_transform: &wgpu::BindGroup,
    ) -> u32 {
        pass.set_bind_group(1, pick_transform, &[]);
        self.draw_run(pass, &self.id_pipeline)
    }
}
```

```rust
use crate::text_gpu_support::GpuCtx;
use crate::text::{TextDocument, TextLabel, TextPlacement, TextRun};
use crate::text_gpu_support::Target;
use glyphon::{
    Cache, Color, ColorMode, Resolution, SwashCache, TextArea, TextAtlas, TextBounds, TextRenderer,
    Viewport,
};
use serde::Serialize;
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct TextFrame {
    pub mvp: [f32; 16],
    pub origin: [f64; 3],
    pub framebuffer: [u32; 2],
    pub logical: [f64; 2],
    pub ortho_half_height: f32,
    pub clip: [[f64; 4]; 6],
}

impl TextFrame {
    fn canvas(&self) -> TextFrame {
        TextFrame {
            mvp: [0.0; 16],
            origin: [0.0; 3],
            ortho_half_height: 0.0,
            clip: [[0.0; 4]; 6],
            ..self.clone()
        }
    }

    pub fn cut(&self, p: [f64; 3]) -> bool {
        self.clip
            .iter()
            .any(|k| k[0] * p[0] + k[1] * p[1] + k[2] * p[2] + k[3] < 0.0)
    }

    pub fn scale(&self) -> anyhow::Result<f32> {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            self.framebuffer[0] > 0 && self.framebuffer[1] > 0,
            "empty text framebuffer"
        );
        anyhow::ensure!(
            self.logical[0].is_finite()
                && self.logical[1].is_finite()
                && self.logical[0] > 0.0
                && self.logical[1] > 0.0,
            "empty text CSS box"
        );
        let x = self.framebuffer[0] as f64 / self.logical[0];
        let y = self.framebuffer[1] as f64 / self.logical[1];
        let tolerance = 1.0 / self.logical[0] + 1.0 / self.logical[1];
        anyhow::ensure!(
            (x - y).abs() <= tolerance,
            "text canvas is stretched non-uniformly"
        );
        Ok(y as f32)
    }
}

struct PlacedText {
    left: f32,
    top: f32,
    scale: f32,
    depth: Option<f32>,
}

fn place(label: &TextLabel, frame: &TextFrame, scale: f32) -> Option<PlacedText> {
    let (world, offset, world_height) = match label.placement {
        TextPlacement::WorldPlane { .. } => return None,
        TextPlacement::Screen { left, top } => {
            return Some(PlacedText {
                left: left * scale,
                top: top * scale,
                scale,
                depth: None,
            });
        }
        TextPlacement::Anchor { world, offset } => (world, offset, None),
        TextPlacement::Nameplate { world, .. } => (world, [0.0; 2], None),
        TextPlacement::WorldBillboard {
            world,
            world_height,
        } => (world, [0.0; 2], Some(world_height)),
    };

    if frame.cut(world) {
        return None;
    }

    let p = [
        (world[0] - frame.origin[0]) as f32,
        (world[1] - frame.origin[1]) as f32,
        (world[2] - frame.origin[2]) as f32,
    ];
    let m = &frame.mvp;
    let w = m[3] * p[0] + m[7] * p[1] + m[11] * p[2] + m[15];

    if !w.is_finite() || w <= 0.0 {
        return None;
    }

    let z = (m[2] * p[0] + m[6] * p[1] + m[10] * p[2] + m[14]) / w;

    if !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&z) {
        return None;
    }

    let x = (m[0] * p[0] + m[4] * p[1] + m[8] * p[2] + m[12]) / w;
    let y = (m[1] * p[0] + m[5] * p[1] + m[9] * p[2] + m[13]) / w;
    let raster_scale = match world_height {
        Some(height) => {
            let projection = (m[1] * m[1] + m[5] * m[5] + m[9] * m[9]).sqrt();
            height as f32 * projection * frame.framebuffer[1] as f32 / (2.0 * w * label.font_size)
        }
        None => scale,
    };

    if !raster_scale.is_finite() || raster_scale <= 0.0 {
        return None;
    }

    Some(PlacedText {
        left: (x + 1.0) * 0.5 * frame.framebuffer[0] as f32 + offset[0] * scale,
        top: (1.0 - y) * 0.5 * frame.framebuffer[1] as f32 + offset[1] * scale,
        scale: raster_scale,
        depth: match label.placement {
            TextPlacement::Nameplate { .. } => None,
            _ => Some(z),
        },
    })
}

fn clip_bounds(label: &TextLabel, frame: &TextFrame, scale: f32) -> TextBounds {
    match label.clip {
        Some(c) => TextBounds {
            left: (c[0] * scale).floor() as i32,
            top: (c[1] * scale).floor() as i32,
            right: (c[2] * scale).ceil() as i32,
            bottom: (c[3] * scale).ceil() as i32,
        },
        None => TextBounds {
            left: 0,
            top: 0,
            right: frame.framebuffer[0] as i32,
            bottom: frame.framebuffer[1] as i32,
        },
    }
}
```
